slices.focus: Nathaniel and Erin meet with a mortgage lender and get a sobering reality check on their homebuying readiness.
slices.summary: A meeting with a mortgage lender reveals Nathaniel and Erin are not yet ready for the neighborhoods they want. They restart a dedicated down-payment fund with automatic transfers, replacing vague optimism with structured saving. The disappointment is real but the clarity is useful.
